basic_profile.bio: An automotive enthusiast hailing from the Pacific Northwest, I'm a 27-year-old who spends my days working as a mechanical engineer. My passion for cars, particularly Subaru WRXs, has been a driving force in my life. When I'm not under the hood, I'm diving into the world of alternative literature and the occasional sci-fi binge, especially if it's Star Wars related. I'm single, enjoying the freedom to travel and attend car meets whenever possible. You can usually find me online in the evenings after work, as well as weekends when I'm not out on a drive.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in mechanical engineering, which I developed through my bachelor's degree and hands-on experience working in an automotive repair shop during college. My love for Subarus is both a hobby and a professional interest, driving me to stay updated on the latest developments and techniques for tuning and maintaining these vehicles.
